label: Friends
tagline: For your group of friends or your student house.
name: The Friends Game

chance.text: The first round is on you. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
Someone is throwing a party at {24}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The group is already at {11}. Hurry up. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
Your phone is almost dead. Go to {12} or {28}, whichever is closer. If someone owns it, pay 10 times your last throw.
You missed the last bus. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
Your lift lets you down. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You win the pub quiz under a fake name.
You know the bouncer. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You follow the wrong group home. Go back three spaces.
You took someone else's bike home. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
The landlord drops by after the house party. Pay {currency}30 per {house} and {currency}120 per {hotel}.
You show up late and buy a round.
The night bus leaves from {5}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
You passed on a secret in the group chat. Pay each player {currency}40.
An old friend pays back what he owes, with interest.
The reunion is at {39}. Go there.

chest.text: The party starts at {0}. Collect your entry money. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
The group kitty was still full after the holiday.
You drop the pizza and fetch a new one.
That one friend finally gives back the money he borrowed.
Someone talked you out of trouble. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You sing too loud on the night bus. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
You win the poker game, for once.
You find money in your old coat pocket.
It is your birthday. Each player gives you {currency}10.
You arrange the festival tickets and everyone pays you back.
You lose the bet on the football.
You pay your share of the taxi.
The waiter undercharges you by mistake.
The house party got out of hand. Pay {currency}35 per {house} and {currency}100 per {hotel}.
You get the deposit back on all the bottles.
You sell your concert tickets on.

houseRules: Whoever sits down last starts with {currency}100 less.
Whoever throws doubles tells a joke. If nobody laughs, pay {currency}10.
Bargaining is always allowed, even if all you trade is a round of drinks.
